explanation.S: Section 87A gives a rebate that can bring your tax down to zero, but the threshold is different in each regime: Old Regime -- taxable income up to Rs 5,00,000. New Regime -- taxable income up to Rs 12,00,000 (a much higher bar, one of the New Regime's main selling points). Important: this is a cliff, not a gradual phase-out. Go even Rs 1 over the threshold and the FULL tax applies from zero -- not just tax on the amount over the limit.
